# Third-party components

Keep upstream source code and license notices clearly separated from original project code.

## FreeSSM

- Repository: https://github.com/Comer352L/FreeSSM

Before vendoring or modifying FreeSSM, review its full license, preserve copyright and license notices, and ensure distribution complies with GPL-3.0. Document the exact upstream commit or release used.
